id: 04_LMG -- Stop Burnout with Routine Laser Maintenance Kiser
title: 一颗螺栓引发的连锁故障
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/04_LMG -- Stop Burnout with Routine Laser Maintenance Kiser.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/04_LMG -- Stop Burnout with Routine Laser Maintenance Kiser/src.py

points.K12: 拆装要拧紧，请合格人员
points.K14: 按厂家要求的周期维护

shots.scene: 欣欣站在桌前，桌上一排多米诺骨牌，旁边一个黄铜镜座
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a workbench with a row of dominoes and a brass lens holder beside them.
shots.narration: 这一课讲一颗螺栓引发的连锁故障。
overlay: 一颗螺栓引发的连锁故障

shots.scene: 螺栓、镜片、水管、喷嘴四个图标依次倒下
shots.prompt_en: Four icons fall one after another like dominoes: a bolt, a round lens, a water tube, and a nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 一个松了，后面接二连三地坏。

shots.scene: 工程训练中心，阿杰在切割机前皱眉，板材没切透
shots.prompt_en: In an engineering training workshop, the young male student frowns at a laser cutting machine; the sheet metal is not cut through.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现：板子怎么切不透了？

shots.scene: 阿杰伸手去调高功率旋钮的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand turning up a power knob on a control panel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 他想把功率调高，硬切下去。

shots.scene: 老李按住他的手，按下暂停键
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stops the young male student's hand and presses the pause button on the machine.
shots.narration: 老李拦住他：先停下，看看哪里变了。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 为什么要停？听一个真实的故障。

shots.scene: 一排多米诺骨牌，第一块被轻轻碰倒
shots.prompt_en: A row of dominoes; the first one is gently tipped over and starts a chain. No people.
shots.narration: 设备故障常常像推倒的多米诺。

shots.scene: 桌上摆着几样烧坏的零件：镜座、橙色镜片、喷嘴、弯折的水管
shots.prompt_en: Damaged parts on a dark bench: a brass lens holder, an orange round lens, a copper nozzle and a bent brown tube. No people.
shots.narration: 这几个坏零件，就是一条故障链。

shots.scene: 示意图：激光器谐振腔两端各有一面镜子，一端透出光束
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a laser tube with a mirror at each end; a beam comes out through one end mirror. No people.
shots.narration: 激光在腔里来回反射，从输出镜射出。

shots.scene: 老李戴手套，举起一片橙色圆镜片
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing gloves, holds up an orange round lens.
shots.narration: 这片橙色镜片，就是输出镜。

shots.scene: 示意图：大部分光反射回腔内，一部分透出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: most of the light reflects back into the tube while a smaller part passes through the output mirror. No people.
shots.narration: 只有一部分光从它透出去。

shots.scene: 示意图：输出镜前有一个短筒形护罩，用螺栓固定
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a short cylindrical shroud held by a bolt sits in front of the output mirror. No people.
shots.narration: 镜前有个护罩，用螺栓固定。

shots.scene: 螺栓一点点退出来，护罩松动
shots.prompt_en: Animation: the bolt slowly backs out and the shroud becomes loose. No people.
shots.narration: 日子久了，螺栓松了或受热退了。

shots.scene: 护罩掉下来，挡在光路前
shots.prompt_en: Animation: the loose shroud drops down and blocks the beam path in front of the mirror. No people.
shots.narration: 护罩掉下来，正好挡在镜子前。

shots.scene: 光束打在护罩上，碎屑向回飞溅到镜面
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the beam strikes the fallen shroud and small fragments spray back onto the mirror surface. No people.
shots.narration: 光束打中护罩，碎屑溅回镜面。

shots.scene: 橙色镜片特写，表面一道裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of an orange round lens with a visible crack across its surface. No people.
shots.narration: 镜片表面裂开了一道缝。

shots.scene: 从侧面看镜片，内部有细小的裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Side view of the lens showing fine cracks inside the material. No people.
shots.narration: 从侧面看，里面也裂了。

shots.scene: 示意图：谐振腔内是低压，外面是大气，镜片隔在中间
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: low pressure inside the laser tube, normal air outside, with the mirror sealing between them. No people.
shots.narration: 这片镜子还是密封的边界。

shots.scene: 镜片向内碎裂，空气涌入腔内的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the cracked mirror breaks inward and outside air rushes into the laser tube. No people.
shots.narration: 腔内气压低，镜片一碎就会向内塌。

shots.scene: 风机卡住、电源冒烟的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a jammed blower and a smoking power supply box. No people.
shots.narration: 风机卡死，电源可能烧坏。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手捂头，身后一个大大的感叹号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds its head with both paws, a large exclamation mark behind it.
shots.narration: 那就是整台激光器的大事故。

shots.scene: 光束斜着反射出去，打在一根冷却水管上
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a deflected beam reflects sideways and hits a cooling water tube. No people.
shots.narration: 跑偏的光，又打中了冷却水管。

shots.scene: 弯折的水管上有一处熔化的口子
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a bent brown tube with a melted hole. No people.
shots.narration: 水管被熔出一个洞。

shots.scene: 水喷到旁边的电气接头上，冒出火花图标
shots.prompt_en: Water sprays from the tube onto nearby electrical connectors, with a small spark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 水喷到了快门的电气接头上。

shots.scene: 示意图：光束本该穿过喷嘴中心的小孔
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a beam should pass straight through the small center hole of a cutting nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 正常时，光从喷嘴中心穿出去。

shots.scene: 光束偏了，打在喷嘴内壁，内壁变色
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the misaligned beam hits the inner wall of the nozzle, which shows heat discoloration. No people.
shots.narration: 光一偏，就打在喷嘴内壁上。

shots.scene: 喷嘴的孔被熔住，只剩周边小孔漏出一点气
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a copper nozzle whose center hole is melted shut, with only a little gas escaping from small side holes. No people.
shots.narration: 孔被焊死，光出不来，只漏点气。

shots.scene: 操作者看到切不透，立刻按下停止键
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sees an incomplete cut and immediately presses the stop button.
shots.narration: 好在操作的人一切不动，马上停机。

shots.scene: 调高功率、调慢速度两个图标，都被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a power knob being turned up and a speed dial being turned down, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不加功率，不降速度，不硬切。

shots.scene: 一个眼睛和放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an eye and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 切不动，说明有东西变了，停下来看。

shots.scene: 示意图：裂纹继续扩展，贯穿整片镜子
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the crack keeps growing until it runs all the way across the lens. No people.
shots.narration: 要是接着切，裂纹就会裂穿。

shots.scene: 天平一边是整台激光器，一边是几个小零件
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale: a whole laser resonator on one side, a few small parts on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 及时停机，只坏了几个小零件。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一块停止标志牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a red stop sign.
shots.narration: 记住：情况突然变了，就停。

shots.scene: 一台机器的速度表一天比一天低
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a machine with a speed gauge dropping lower each day on a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 拖着不维护，机器越跑越慢。

shots.scene: 速度表突然归零，机器停摆
shots.prompt_en: The speed gauge suddenly drops to zero and the machine stops. No people.
shots.narration: 最后突然罢工，损失更大。

shots.scene: 老李拿着扳手和空白检查表站在机器旁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands beside the machine with a wrench and a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 例行维护，就是在出大事前发现问题。

shots.section_title: 拆装要拧紧，请合格人员
shots.scene: 老李拆下护罩，检查后再装回去
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the shroud, inspects it, and fits it back into place.
shots.narration: 维护时，这个护罩要拆下来再装回。
overlay: 拆装要拧紧，请合格人员

shots.section_title: 拆装要拧紧，请合格人员
shots.scene: 护罩装在狭窄角落里，手很难够到
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the shroud sits in a tight corner where a hand can barely reach. No people.
shots.narration: 位置又窄又难够，容易没拧紧。

shots.section_title: 拆装要拧紧，请合格人员
shots.scene: 老李用一把专用扳手把螺栓拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens the bolt with a special long wrench.
shots.narration: 合格的人，用合适的工具，才拧得牢。

shots.scene: 日历一页页翻过，护罩一直松着
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flip by over several months while the shroud stays loose. No people.
shots.narration: 这个护罩松了好几个月，没人发现。

shots.scene: 老李打开机器检查，一眼看到松动的护罩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the machine during maintenance and spots the loose shroud right away.
shots.narration: 按时维护，一打开就能发现。

shots.section_title: 按厂家要求的周期维护
shots.scene: 空白说明书旁一个运行计时器
shots.prompt_en: A blank equipment manual next to a running-hours counter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 维护周期按厂家要求，按运行小时算。
overlay: 按厂家要求的周期维护

shots.section_title: 按厂家要求的周期维护
shots.scene: 日夜交替的机器，计时器转得飞快
shots.prompt_en: A machine under alternating sun and moon icons, its hour counter spinning quickly. No people.
shots.narration: 开得越久，维护就要越勤。

shots.scene: 老周看着停着的机器，旁边堆着订单
shots.prompt_en: The older man looks at a stopped laser cutting machine with a pile of blank job sheets beside it.
shots.narration: 不想停机，结果停得更久。

shots.scene: 日历上两天被划掉，再加扳手和时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with two days crossed out, then a wrench and a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 等人、维修、重新调机，都要时间。

shots.scene: 老李在停下的机器上挂空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hangs a blank out-of-service tag on the stopped laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 停机以后，挂上停用牌。

shots.scene: 阿杰给老周打电话报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student calls the older man on the phone to report the problem.
shots.narration: 马上报告负责老师和设备管理员。

shots.scene: 自己重新开机的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand restarting a tagged machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没查清原因，不能自己重新开机。

shots.scene: 示意图：反射光从机器缝隙射出，指向一个人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a stray reflected beam escapes through a gap in the machine housing toward a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 跑偏的光，也可能射出机外伤人。

shots.scene: 关好的机门、防护眼镜、激光警告标志三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a closed machine door, laser safety goggles, and a laser warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 门要关好，需要时戴对波长的眼镜。

shots.scene: 人从侧面缝隙往里看的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person peeking into a gap in the machine housing, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别从缝隙往里看。

shots.scene: 老李对照空白检查表，逐项检查螺栓和接头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks bolts and fittings one by one against a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 修完对照清单，逐项检查紧固。

shots.scene: 老李关好机门试机，小研在旁记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer runs a test with the door closed while the female graduate student records in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 授权人员试机正常，再交回使用。

shots.scene: 老李戴上手套和护目镜，拿起烧坏的喷嘴
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on gloves and safety glasses before picking up a burned nozzle.
shots.narration: 拿烧坏的零件，戴手套和护目镜。

shots.scene: 徒手拿满是黑灰的零件的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of bare hands holding a soot-covered part, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 烧蚀的黑灰不要用手抹。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现停止、扳手、检查表、停用牌、眼镜五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five icons: a stop sign, a wrench, a checklist, an out-of-service tag, and safety goggles.
shots.narration: 情况一变就停，挂牌报告。

shots.scene: 老李把护罩拧紧，阿杰在旁边看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens the shroud while the young male student watches.
shots.narration: 按时维护，拧紧检查，再试机。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、老李站在切割机旁挥手，多米诺骨牌稳稳立着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the young male student and the facility engineer, a row of dominoes standing firmly beside them.
shots.narration: 别让第一块骨牌倒下。
